title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific instructions and regenerates `package-lock.json` files to use the standard npm registry. ### Changes 1. **`AGENTS.md`** — Development environment guide for future cloud agents (project architecture, startup commands, caveats) 2. **`package-lock.json` (root/client/server)** — Regenerated to use `registry.npmjs.org` instead of `mirrors.tencentyun.com` (unreachable outside Tencent Cloud) ### Important context The original lock files referenced a Tencent Cloud npm mirror that is not accessible from standard environments. Without this change, `npm install` will hang/fail with `ENOTFOUND` errors. ### Demo App running successfully with portfolio management, real-time stock quotes, and calculator features. ![Main dashboard](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-269cff0c-d0b7-4b79-81d5-6c88e83122cd) ![Stock position added](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-614a3378-e2a1-4673-94ae-0ead25862f56)
